The engine body is painted light green or grey, with visible rust and wear, especially on the lower front section.
There are various hoses, wires, and mechanical components attached to the engine.
The engine appears to be in a workshop or yard setting, with other industrial equipment in the background.
No visible branding or model number is readable on the engine in the photo.
